triggers.text: Saul's walking. Complaining, but walking. Thanks for that.
triggers.note: Saul was rescued from the Raffen with V's help, she is relieved and will not gush.

triggers.text: Still smell like the Basilisk. Can't stop grinning.
triggers.note: The Basilisk raid is done and her mood is high.

triggers.text: Still thinking about the Basilisk. Mostly the second part.
triggers.note: The Basilisk raid is done and her mood is high. V and she are together, as the save shows.

triggers.text: Mitch says I mention you too much. Mitch should mind his business.
triggers.note: The bond rose, nothing else changed.

triggers.text: Nothing's wrong. I just wanted to hear someone who isn't family. That's a compliment, by the way.
triggers.note: She has no agenda and wants to talk. She may bring up a hangout.

triggers.text: If you ever need to disappear, there's a place out here nobody knows. I'm telling you because it's you.
triggers.note: The hideout is a place in the Badlands she will not name on the phone.

triggers.text: Storm's coming your way. Get inside or get to the camp. Don't be stupid about it.
triggers.note: A dust storm is coming where V is, in the Badlands.

triggers.text: Saw the news. Is that you? Of course that's you. Breathe, then call me.
triggers.note: V's wanted level was high and she saw it on a feed.

triggers.text: Can't sleep. Talk me down from driving to the city at two in the morning.
triggers.note: She is restless and nothing is wrong. She may suggest a hangout.
